EmailEventIn.title: EmailEventIn
EmailEventIn.description:
A bounce, complaint or unsubscribe report from the sending relay.

``message-id`` is accepted as an alias so a Brevo webhook payload can be
posted without reshaping it. ``event_id`` is optional; when the provider
does not supply one it is derived from the event, message and recipient.

NotificationRead.title: NotificationRead
NotificationRead.description:
A single notification.

Only a title, a one-line summary and an app link — by design there is no
message-content field, so no email built from this row can include one.
